abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.paraphrase: Ranged attacks targeting this unit are at -1 to Hit.

abilities.name: Feel No Pain
abilities.paraphrase: Each time a model would lose a wound, it is not lost on a roll of X+.

abilities.name: Fights First
abilities.paraphrase: Fights in the Fights First step if every model has this ability.

abilities.name: Deep Strike
abilities.paraphrase: Can be set up in Reserves and arrive more than 9" from all enemy models.

abilities.name: Infiltrators
abilities.paraphrase: Deploys anywhere more than 9" from the enemy deployment zone and all enemy models.

abilities.name: Scout
abilities.paraphrase: Pre-game move of up to X", ending more than 9" from all enemy models.

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.paraphrase: Can attach to a Bodyguard unit; attacks cannot be allocated to this Character without Precision.

abilities.name: Deadly Demise
abilities.paraphrase: When destroyed, on a D6 roll of 6 each unit within 6" suffers X mortal wounds.

abilities.name: Firing Deck
abilities.paraphrase: X embarked models can shoot through this Transport.
